producer_report.summary: I split the long `planning_round` in planning.rs into three private methods, with no behavior change. `critic_round` now holds the critic half. `stop_on_mechanical_limit` holds the stop after Athena's own plan rules still fail on the last mechanical pass. `planning_round` keeps the planner call and Athena's own checks and shrinks to about 170 lines, down from 291 by code health's measure. I added a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md. `cargo test -p athena-core`, `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`, clippy with `-D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.

mistakes: I first left an unused `last_round` variable in planning_round after the split. The compiler warned and I removed it.
learnings: The Bash tool here allows only cargo, git, ls, chmod, mv and rm, with no pipes, grep, tail or echo. Use `cargo test -q` to keep the output short.
